newsitem.title: USA: Webco Industries says mill to contribute Q3.
newsitem.headline: Webco Industries says mill to contribute Q3.

text.p: Webco Industries Inc said on Tuesday that higher shipments and a new mill helped first- quarter sales reach records and profits rise 441 percent.

Webco chairman and chief executive officer William Weber said the new weld mill produced 6,889 tons of steel products in the quarter. He added that the company should benefit from the full potential of the mill by the third quarter.

Webeco Industries, which makes carbon steel tubing and stainless steel tubing products, said sales reached $28.4 million, up 26 percent from year-ago results. Net income reached $634,000, up from $117,000 in fiscal 1996.
